d:
Jharkhand vidhanasbha men MMDR (Mines and Minerals Development and Regulation) sanshodhan ko lekar satta paksh aur vipaksh aamne-samne najar aae. sadan men is mudde par jamkar bahas huee. mukhyamantri hemant soren ne MMDR ko jharkhand ke hit men nahin batate hue kendr sarkar par saval uthae. aakhir sadan men kya kuchh huaa aur satta-vipaksh ke bich kis bat ko lekar huee tikhi bahas? dekhie puri riporta.
